patterns_to_follow.description: Test setup with real runner and bare repo for classifier dispatch tests
patterns_to_follow.example:
bareRepo := testutil.InitBareRepoWithMainWorktree(t)
defaultBranch := testutil.GetDefaultBranch(t, bareRepo)
db := testutil.NewTestDB(t)
projectID := uuid.New()
events := make(chan Event, 100)
wt := worktree.NewManager(bareRepo, defaultBranch)
project := model.Project{ID: projectID, Name: "test", BareRepoPath: bareRepo, DefaultBranch: defaultBranch}
db.Create(&project)
binDir := t.TempDir()
fakeBin := filepath.Join(binDir, "fake-claude")
os.WriteFile(fakeBin, []byte("#!/bin/sh\ncat > /dev/null\nexit 0\n"), 0o755)
runner := agent.NewRunner(db, nil, wt, fakeBin, "", 4, nil)
orch := &Orchestrator{db: db, projectID: projectID, worktree: wt, runner: runner, events: events, contextWarnPct: 75, contextStopPct: 90, contextFixerPct: 85, logger: slog.Default().With("component", "test")}

patterns_to_follow.description: Setting task Context before tick and reloading after
patterns_to_follow.example:
task := testutil.CreateTask(t, db, projectID, "title", model.StatusClassifying)
task.Context = model.JSONField{"total_classifier_spawns": float64(3)}
db.Save(&task)
orch.doTick(nil)
var reloaded model.Task
db.First(&reloaded, "id = ?", task.ID)
// Assert on reloaded fields
